hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
Leitre, a Skou language spoken in to the east of Vanimo on the north coast of Papua New Guinea, is a distinct language from Vanimo [vam]
(**hh:hvphon:Donohue:Skou**, **hh:hvld:DonohueCrowther:NCNG**,
**hh:g:DonohueRoque:Isaka**:6-7 and p.c. Matthew Dryer 2022) and missing from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. I wish to thank Matthew Dryer for bringing this language to my attention. See also: Vanimo [vam].
